Apple Event September 2022: Apple Watch Ultra summary slide

A light summary slide for Apple Watch Ultra in which one product color, safety orange, carries every key figure across pale grey tiles.

Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Apple introduced Apple Watch Ultra at its event on 7 September 2022, the same event as the iPhone 14 Pro slide.

Observed

  • Pale grey tiles with large rounded corners sit on an off-white ground with narrow even gutters. About twenty tiles range from small pills (“ECG”, “LTE”, “Blood oxygen”) to a tall central tile with three views of the watch.
  • Key figures and words are set very large in bold orange: “60 hrs battery life”, “GPS”, “2000 nits”, “EN13319”. Labels are small and black.
  • Four tiles are black-and-white photographs (mountains, divers, a storm) with the orange figure set over the photo.
  • “WR100” and “MIL-STD 810” are set in a monospaced face, in blue and in black with orange.
  • Product photos of the watch and its bands are cropped by the tile edges.

Why it belongs

The slide shows how the look takes a brand accent: the tiles stay neutral, and one product color marks every figure. The black-and-white photo tiles keep the accent the only color on the slide.

Borrow

Choose one accent from the product and use it only for figures and key words.

Desaturate photo tiles so that the accent figure on them stays the strongest color.
